description: This file defines the StandardJavaEngine class, which extends GenericAsyncEngine, providing functionality to invoke static Java methods dynamically for service execution within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages method invocation, error handling, and integrates with the service dispatcher and context.

classes.name: StandardJavaEngine
classes.description: A service engine that invokes static Java methods to execute services, supporting dynamic class loading and method invocation.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to run a service asynchronously and ignore the result.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Runs the service synchronously, returning a Map of results, and throws an exception if the result is not a Map.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Performs reflection-based invocation of a static Java method specified by the service model, passing the dispatch context and service parameters.
